name: No-Peek Juicy Chicken Breast
desc: Chicken breasts seared on one side, then gently steamed covered with the heat off.

source.title: Perfect Juicy Chicken Breast (no-peek method)
source.evidence: Saved Instagram reel; caption and on-screen text captured in the owner's saved-recipes export

ingredients.raw: 1 1/2 lb boneless skinless chicken breasts (2 large or 4 small)

steps: Pat the chicken dry. Mix the salt, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika and pepper and season the chicken well on both sides.
Heat the oil in a large skillet with a tight-fitting lid over medium heat. Add the chicken and don't move it for 5 minutes.
Flip the chicken, pour in the water and cover.
Keep the heat on for 2 minutes (4 minutes for a thin pan or large breasts), then turn the heat off. On an electric stove, move the pan off the burner.
Leave it covered for 15 minutes without lifting the lid.
Check the thickest part with an instant-read thermometer: it must read 165°F. If it doesn't, cover and cook over low heat a few minutes more.
Rest the chicken on a board for a few minutes, then slice.
tips: The sear gives color and the covered steam finishes the chicken gently, which keeps it juicy.
The seasoning is a suggestion: the creator says to season however you like, as long as you season well.

references.title: Juicy chicken breast method (creator's caption)
